# Visakan Kirubakaran

> Personal portfolio of Visakan Kirubakaran, a software developer with a passion for software and web development, based in Ottawa, ON, Canada.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vikiru.vercel.app/): Homepage of Visakan Kirubakaran, showcasing his skills, education, academic and personal projects, and finally, contact information.
- [Courses](https://vikiru.vercel.app/education/courses): University courses taken during his Bachelor of Software Engineering degree at Carleton University.
- [Sitemap](https://vikiru.vercel.app/sitemap): Visual index of all pages on the site.

## Projects

### Personal Projects

- [Noterra](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/Noterra): AI-powered learning tool to generate comprehensive notes and flashcards from given user prompts, powered by Gemini AI.
- [Paleodra](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/Paleodra): A dinosaur discovery web application that allows users to explore, learn about, and track dinosaur species.
- [Grocadex](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/Grocadex): A React Native mobile app designed to help users track their grocery expenses and monitor expiry dates.
- [Kelbrum](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/Kelbrum): An anime recommendation system designed to recommend anime that is similar to user-selected anime.
- [Parseum](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/Parseum): A markdown to HTML parser and editor built using Peggy.js, React, TailwindCSS and DaisyUI.
- [RESTasaurus](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/RESTasaurus): A dinosaur REST API built using Express, MongoDB and Mongoose with comprehensive data for almost 1200 dinosaurs.
- [Urvo](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/Urvo): A multi-purpose Discord bot with over 65 commands across 8 categories, aiming to enhance user experience and interactivity.

### Academic Projects

- [CodeSmell](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/CodeSmell): A tool for detection and visualization of code smells for object-oriented languages, a final year university capstone project completed with 3 co-authors.
- [discrete-sim](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/discrete-sim): A simulation of a manufacturing facility, with the intent of optimizing product production through statistical analysis and simulation modeling.
- [Mini-SurveyMonkey](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/Mini-SurveyMonkey): A SurveyMonkey clone built as a Spring Boot CRUD Web Application, enabling survey creation, modification, and PDF export of results, completed with 2 co-authors.
- [Elevator Simulator](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/Elevator-Simulator): A simulation of an elevator transporting passengers among floors, with the capability to introduce and handle errors that may arise during operation, completed with 3 co-authors. 
- [Digital Risk](https://vikiru.vercel.app/projects/digitalRisk): Digital Risk is a re-creation of the board game Risk: Global Domination using Java Swing and following the MVC design pattern, completed with 3 co-authors.
